title: Named Entity Recognition
description:
A text processing component that identifies and extracts named entities from text using 
state-of-the-art transformer models. It can detect and classify entities such as persons, 
organizations, locations, dates, and more. The extracted entities are added to document 
metadata for enhanced search, filtering, and analysis capabilities.</br>
</br>
The component supports multiple pre-trained models optimized for different languages and 
use cases, from general-purpose entity recognition to specialized domains.
